children.title: Autogear
children.subtitle: An automatic derailleur that learns when to shift
children.summary: A startup idea turned R&D: a plug-and-play box that shifts a regular bike's gears by itself, without a torque sensor, using a model that imitates an experienced cyclist on an Arduino.
children.coverAlt: A student pedals the Autogear prototype on a home trainer while a teammate watches the data
children.metaTitle: Autogear, an Automatic Derailleur That Learns When to Shift · Tancrède Amiel
children.metaDescription: An entrepreneurship project turned embedded-ML R&D: a plug-and-play automatic bicycle derailleur without a torque sensor, driven by a two-stage model that imitates an experienced cyclist on an Arduino.

children.title: Concert hall absorbers
children.subtitle: Optimal placement of absorbing material in a concert hall
children.summary: Where to put a fixed amount of porous material: Helmholtz model, well-posedness and adjoint gradient.
children.metaTitle: Optimal Placement of Absorbing Material in a Concert Hall · Tancrède Amiel
children.metaDescription: Helmholtz model, well-posedness proof and adjoint gradient to place porous material on concert-hall walls. CentraleSupélec ST5; my part: source model and theory.
children.coverAlt: The main hall of the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam during a concert

children.title: Variational Tensor Neural Networks: A Critical Analysis
children.subtitle: A close reading of Jahromi & Orús, Scientific Reports (2024)
children.summary: A critical analysis: tensor layers trained like DMRG inside deep networks, a new way to read a network while it trains.
children.coverAlt: Three intertwined spirals classified by a tensor neural network (figure from Jahromi and Orús, 2024)
children.metaTitle: Variational Tensor Neural Networks, a Critical Analysis · Tancrède Amiel
children.metaDescription: A critical analysis of Jahromi & Orús (Scientific Reports, 2024) for the Information & Physics course at CentraleSupélec: no breakthrough in compression or scalability, but tensor layers trained like DMRG inside hybrid networks, which make entanglement readable during training.
